programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Talking Ben crea un nuevo sistema de inteligencia artificial, SARA, para ayudar a controlar las cosas en el garaje. Pero SARA rápidamente se enamora de Talking Tom — y ve a Talking Angela como su rival romántica.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Mar
programme.desc: Alex vive en una isla y se prepara cada mañana un desayuno mientras Rocco y Lili juegan juntos. Un científico holográfico aparece en una máquina y le dice a Alex cual es su misión para el día: Alex ha de fotografiar un delfín. Descubrirá todo tipo de vida submarina. Después de un rato, Alex ve un delfín y toma una foto de él. Luego, regresa de vuelta a casa. Al final, una voz explica las características de los delfines.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: BarryTiger

Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Leo Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger presenta los secretos y las maravillas de la naturaleza y la vida silvestre que nos rodea y estimula la curiosidad y la pasión por la naturaleza en los niños. Con interesantes misiones y aventuras, los niños se divierten mientras aprenden lecciones positivas.

programme.title: A cantar con Fluffy la Conejita

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals
programme.desc: Brainy dons his safari hat and roams the forest to do good deeds for animals. He mostly gives advice to the creatures but balks when he can really save the life of a wildcat being hunted by Gargamel. Nat gives Brainy the courage to free the cat from Gargamel's trap.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs
programme.desc: The Wartmongers are draining Smurf River to make mud for their wrestling matches. Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs take Grandpa Smurf to the King's castle so that he can meet Peewit. But what with one thing and another (especially another), the Smurfs and Peewit are taken aboard a Viking long ship. The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.desc: Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: In our very first solo episode of Rooted in Wellness, we explore the transformative power of being anchored like a sturdy tree—steady, grounded, and unwavering amidst life's storms. We'll illuminate how feeling rooted manifests as inner peace, emotional stability, and a profound connection with yourself and the world around you.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Have you ever felt like your hormones are playing a tune out of sync with your well-being? Chances are, they probably are. The good news? There's a transformative journey waiting for women when they realign with nature, pay attention to their meals, and practice intermittent fasting the right way.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Did you know that your metabolic health and energy are controlled by our modern food? This means your metabolism is not broken! You just need to work on healing your metabolism through simple lifestyle shifts you can easily apply to your life today.How? This is what we dive into in this episode of Rooted in Wellness with Casey Means.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.desc: Red y Dembe intentan por todos los medios cumplir los últimos deseos de un viejo amigo. Aram se infiltra como intérprete en una empresa que proporciona servicios a criminales y, mientras, Park ayuda a un amigo con problemas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Con su imperio criminal en ruinas, un Red sorprendentemente despreocupado recluta a Liz en un plan poco probable para ganar efectivo simultáneamente y entregar a un nuevo Blacklister al Task Force. Mientras Liz se enfrenta a la nueva realidad de trabajar junto a su padre, Ressler se encuentra en una posición precaria y Tom sopesa sus opciones.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: En un intento por presionar a Ian Garvey, Red y el Task Force se dirigen a París para localizar a un importante proveedor de heroína para el Sindicato Nash. Sin fiarse de la agenda de Red, Liz toma su propio camino para ir tras Garvey.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz utiliza información de una fuente inesperada para provocar una carrera con Red a descubrir los secretos que guarda, mientras Red inicia un plan para recuperar la bolsa de huesos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La misteriosa aparición de una joven no identificada envía a Liz y al Task Force a una cacería para descubrir su conexión con el secreto que esconde Red. Sin embargo, cuando su familia interviene para proteger sus propios secretos, la investigación se convierte en una carrera para salvar la vida de la niña.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Samar acaba en el punto de mira de una lista negra poco convencional, Aram y el Task Force entran en acción para encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Mientras tanto, Red viaja a Costa Rica para evitar que vendan la bolsa de huesos al mejor postor en una subasta subterránea.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y Red se enfrentan en una carrera climática para encontrar a un Blacklister en posesión de la bolsa de huesos, forzando que, finalmente, la verdad sobre los huesos salga a la luz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo rastrea a un médico que ayuda a delincuentes a crear nuevas identidades, Liz y Jennifer unen sus fuerzas para saber cómo Red se ha hecho pasar por su padre durante más de treinta años.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo se une a Red para impedir un ataque a la ONU.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Liz y el equipo rastrean a un notorio biohacker clandestino, Red inicia una estrategia para salir de una situación complicada. Mientras tanto, la integridad de Cooper se pone a prueba con una difícil elección.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red se aclimata a su nuevo entorno en la prisión federal, donde un antiguo rival lo desafía. Samar va de incógnito para detener una organización del mercado negro que vende dinero a delincuentes. Mientras tanto, Liz y Jennifer continúan su investigación sobre el pasado de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red sostiene en los tribunales la validez de su acuerdo de inmunidad, Liz y el equipo interrogan a un hombre cuya reciente herencia parece demasiado buena para ser cierta, y Dembe le da algunos consejos a Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando envían a Red a una institución médica federal tras su solicitud al tribunal para una evaluación psiquiátrica, Liz y Jennifer aprovechan su ausencia para buscar a un individuo de la lista negra que creen que puede tener información valiosa sobre el pasado de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red y Dembe consiguen la ayuda de Glenn para poner al jurado a favor de Red en su próximo juicio, el equipo investiga una serie de misteriosas muertes provocadas por insectos transformados en armas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Liz y Jennifer buscan a una mujer que puede conocer un secreto sobre el pasado de Red, se colocan en el punto de mira de un despiadado contrabandista, obligando a Liz a pedir ayuda a una fuente inesperada. Mientras tanto, Red hace de mediador entre dos bandas rivales en prisión.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red lucha en los tribunales por limpiar su nombre como traidor de una vez por todas, Liz y el equipo investigan a un individuo de la lista negra conocido por sus oscuros secretos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo se adentra en el mundo no regulado de la criptodivisa para detener un ataque inminente, mientras que Red lleva a cabo un arriesgado intento de asegurar su libertad.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y el equipo hacen una jugada para descubrir la verdad sobre un asesinato internacional en un último esfuerzo por salvar la vida de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cooper arriesga su reputación para apelar a la Casa Blanca en nombre de Red, mientras Liz y el equipo reanudan su búsqueda de El Corso, un individuo de la lista negra relacionado con una conspiración internacional. Mientras tanto, las habilidades de Samar en el campo se ponen a prueba.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el equipo buscan al legendario fugitivo Robert Vesco, uno de los estafadores más destacados de la historia. Mientras tanto, Samar toma una decisión que le cambiará la vida.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red dirige a Liz para que investigue una organización secreta de asesinos contratada por agencias de inteligencia global para eliminar a antiguos agentes: un caso con ramificaciones que cambiarán al equipo para siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red (James Spader) recluta a Tom y a la Fuerza de Tareas para rastrear a un famoso cazarrecompensas que podría conocer los movimientos de Alexander Kirk. Mientras, Liz (Megan Boone) se pregunta si Kirk es confiable.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red (James Spader) recurre a informadores para tratar de encontrar al topo, Liz (Megan Boone) persigue a un científico perturbado que ha ayudado a escapar a docenas de criminales creando dobles genéticos para luego matarlos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Recuerdos del pasado hacen que Red se cruce en el camino de un enemigo que está dispuesto a destruir su imperio delictivo.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La fuerza especial persigue a un hábil cazarrecompensas, cuyo objetivo son los socios más cercanos a Red. Mientras tanto, Ressler se enfrenta a un dilema moral cuando asume un nuevo compromiso con un antiguo colega.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Un justiciero psicópata persigue a Liz, mientras que Red y el Sr. Kaplan se preparan para su último enfrentamiento.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo busca a una mujer especializada en adquisiciones hostiles de organizaciones criminales que puede tener información relacionada con una conspiración internacional que involucra a la asesora presidencial Anna McMahon. Mientras tanto, Aram promulga un atrevido plan para sacar ventaja a Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y Ressler investigan a un individuo de la lista negra que ofrece borrar las deudas de juego... a un precio engañosamente alto. Mientras tanto, Dembe se preocupa cuando Red pone a prueba las lealtades de sus socios en busca del individuo que lo delató a la policía.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red envía al equipo especial a investigar a Roanoke, un criminal legendario que organiza elaboradas extracciones. Mientras, Liz sigue comunicándose en secreto con Katarina Rostova.

Un poderoso avión espía experimental es robado por un malvado traficante de armas y está a punto de ser vendido a un grupo terrorista internacional. El gobierno de los Estados Unidos prepara a un boxeador egocéntrico (Murphy) para que se una al sofisticado agente especial (Wilson) en una peligrosa misión secreta para recuperar el avión. Armado con los últimos artilugios tecnológicos y mucho carácter, esta extraña pareja podría ser capaz de salvar el mundo, si se pudiesen llevar bien.

Cuando el torpe policía Frank Dooley (Candy) y el inepto abogado Norman Kane (Levy) pierden sus trabajos, comienzan a trabajar en la Guard Dog Security Company, donde los robos se producen justo debajo de sus narices.

programme.title: Los Angeles De Charlie Al Limite
programme.desc: Las tres agentes están de vuelta; Los ángeles están dispuestas a dar guerra para recuperar una información encriptada en dos anillos, que revela las identidades de todas las personas acogidas al programa de protección de testigos. Cuando éstos empiezan a morir, sólo las intrépidas chicas podrán detener al responsable, usando su experiencia en el camuflaje, espionaje y artes marciales. Además se las tendrán que ver con un ángel caído -Demi Moore-.

Pero para Crunch no se tratará sólo del libro, sino al mismo tiempo tener la posibilidad de reescribir algunos capítulos de su propio pasado.

programme.title: El Libro de Eli
programme.desc: Eli (Denzel Washington), un guerrero solitario, camina en una tierra arrasada por la hecatombe; una tierra que una vez fue los Estados Unidos. Se dirige hacia el Oeste para llevar a cabo una misión que no acaba de entender del todo pero que sabe que debe cumplir. Protege con su vida la última copia de un libro sagrado que puede ser la llave para salvar la humanidad. En esta secuela, cargada de la locura y diversión que les caracteriza, estos 4 supervivientes viajarán desde la Casa Blanca al corazón del país, luchando contra nuevos tipos de zombis que han evolucionado desde la primera película, y encontrando nuevos supervivientes humanos. programme.desc: Una joven mujer asiste a los servicios religiosos de la tarde y luego desaparece.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Cuando una niña de 9 años desaparece, la policía y los voluntarios pasan semanas buscándola.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: El video de seguridad muestra que lo que parece ser un encuentro casual es en realidad un secuestro forzado.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: La mujer había sido agredida sexualmente, apuñalada repetidamente y dada por muerta.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: La víctima era un hombre que se forjó a sí mismo que nunca medía sus palabras.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Investigadores buscan probar que hubo juego sucio en la muerte de una mujer durante sus vacaciones.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Los testigos vieron a una mujer en la parte trasera de un camión, agitando los brazos y gritando.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Después de que una pareja fuera atacada en su casa, su hijo se vuelve el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Dos sospechosos están vinculados a un asesinato por botas manchadas de sangre y una pistola.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Detectives investigan una serie de explosiones en varias iglesias de Illinois.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: No había una razón clara para que un estudiante universitario joven y saludable estuviera muerto.

programme.title: El enviado
programme.desc: Cuando su hijo de ocho años muere, una pareja afligida recurre a un genetista que consigue clonar a su hijo, con resultados aterradores en este trepidante Suspenso de suspense.

programme.title: Nación cautiva
programme.desc: Casi una década después de que una fuerza extraterrestre tomara el control de Chicago, las amenazas a las libertades civiles y la disidencia dentro de un estado autoritario ponen de manifiesto la realidad del estado de vigilancia moderno.

programme.title: Los elegidos
programme.desc: Cuando la tranquila vida suburbana de la familia Barret se ve alterada por una serie creciente de eventos perturbadores, se dan cuenta de que una fuerza aterradora y mortal está detrás de ellos.

programme.title: Inestable
programme.desc: Cuando una mujer encuentra a un hombre que ella cree que es su alma gemela, cosas extrañas comienzan a suceder en su vida haciéndola creer que se está volviendo loca.

programme.title: En estado crítico
programme.desc: Cuando un médico joven e idealista se encarga del caso de un paciente rico con una enfermedad terminal, queda atrapado en una red de dudas éticas y de pérfido erotismo para el que ninguna facultad de medicina podía prepararle.

programme.title: El Dr. T. y las mujeres
programme.desc: Un atractivo ginecólogo (Richard Gere) en plena crisis tiene tantos problemas con su familia como consigo mismo. Por suerte, conoce a una mujer (Helen Hunt) que podría tener la solución.

programme.title: En estado crítico
programme.desc: Cuando un médico joven e idealista se encarga del caso de un paciente rico con una enfermedad terminal, queda atrapado en una red de dudas éticas y de pérfido erotismo para el que ninguna facultad de medicina podía prepararle.

programme.title: El Dr. T. y las mujeres
programme.desc: Un atractivo ginecólogo (Richard Gere) en plena crisis tiene tantos problemas con su familia como consigo mismo. Por suerte, conoce a una mujer (Helen Hunt) que podría tener la solución.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Cuando el amnésico Jericho conoce a un carismático predicador vaquero llamado Joshua, se embarcan en un peligroso viaje para desentrañar la identidad perdida de Jericho y escapar del peligro.

programme.title: Rompiendo las reglas
programme.desc: Un adolescente rebelde comienza en una nueva escuela, donde se ve atrapado en la escena de la lucha subterránea. Ayudado por un especialista en artes marciales mixtas, se prepara para asumir su mayor desafío hasta la fecha: su archienemigo que resulta ser un campeón de lucha.

programme.title: Entre dos mundos
programme.desc: La línea que separa los dos mundos de nuestra historia, nos permitirá entrar en un místico y pacífico valle donde todas las fuerzas del Universo se enfrentan.

programme.title: Jinetes desesperados
programme.desc: En este wéstern protagonizado por la estrella del country Trace Adkins, Tom Berenger y Drew Waters, un héroe solitario y una guapa tiradora ayudan a un niño a rescatar a su madre, que ha sido raptada por un forajido.

programme.title: Beyond Sherwood Forest
programme.desc: Inglaterra, siglo XII. Es una época difícil de tiranía y magia oscura. El arquero forajido conocido como Robin Hood deberá enfrentarse al sheriff de Nottingham cuando este deja suelto a un monstruo alado para que ataque los pueblos y los bosques, acabe con los hombres de Robin y secuestre a Maid Marian.

programme.title: El sustituto 3: Aulas violentas
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de su amigo es brutalmente agredida, un mercenario se infiltra en un colegio para averiguar más sobre la banda responsable del ataque.

programme.title: Desde París con amor
programme.desc: Un agente de inteligencia de bajo rango que trabaja con el embajador de EE.UU. en Francia asume más de lo que esperaba cuando se asocia con un agente estadounidense de alto rango que ha sido enviado a París para detener un ataque terrorista.

programme.title: Riddick
programme.desc: Tras ser dado por muerto en un planeta abrasado por el sol, Riddick debe luchar por sobrevivir frente a depredadores alienígenas y cazadores de recompensas.

programme.title: El sustituto 3: Aulas violentas
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de su amigo es brutalmente agredida, un mercenario se infiltra en un colegio para averiguar más sobre la banda responsable del ataque.

programme.title: The Eye (Visiones)
programme.desc: Una chica ciega recibe un trasplante de córnea para poder recuperar la vista. Sin embargo, recibe más de lo que esperaba cuando se da cuenta de que puede ver inquietantes fantasmas.

programme.title: Historias de miedo para contar en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Mill Valley, Pennsylvania, noche de Halloween, 1968. Después de gastar una broma a un matón de la escuela, Sarah y sus amigos deciden colarse en una casa supuestamente embrujada que una vez perteneció a la poderosa familia Bellows, desatando fuerzas oscuras que no podrán controlar.

programme.title: La casa del reloj en la pared
programme.desc: Un joven huérfano llamado Lewis Barnavelt ayuda a su mágico tío a encontrar un reloj con el poder de provocar el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Twist
programme.desc: Moderna versión de Oliver Twist. Un joven grafitero y experto en parkour se une a la banda de estafadores de Fagin para llevar a cabo el robo del siglo. Entre persecuciones, traiciones y romances, deberá decidir en quién puede confiar mientras lucha por hacerse con una valiosa obra de arte.

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: Cuando Bigfoot ataca un concierto de música con temática de los 80, un promotor del concierto y un hippie agotado harán cualquier cosa para proteger a las "especies en peligro de extinción".

programme.title: Asesinos Anónimos
programme.desc: Periódicamente se celebra un grupo de apoyo para asesinos. Los participantes se sientan en un círculo de confianza y comparten sus transgresiones.

programme.title: Pequeño gran guerrero
programme.desc: Un viejo soldado secuestra a un joven general de un estado enemigo y lo lleva en un largo viaje para conseguir la recompensa.

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas
programme.desc: Recién enviudado, un hombre ve alterada la tranquilidad de su aislada casa de campo cuando un policía irrumpe persiguiendo a dos criminales. La llegada del resto de la banda y del compañero del agente desencadena un enfrentamiento mortal en el que todos luchan por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Juego Mortal
programme.desc: Nueve amigos, cada uno con un oscuro secreto, se reúnen para acampar en el bosque. Tras una noche de fiesta, despiertan con bombas suicidas atadas al pecho y diferentes tiempos de cuenta atrás. Mientras buscan una forma de desactivarlas o pedir ayuda, descubren algo aterrador: el tiempo restante puede pasar de una persona a otra.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon viaja a la montaña para esparcir las cenizas de su padre, pero presencia el asesinato de un traficante a manos de una policía corrupta. Perseguida por ella y sus familiares, también agentes corruptos, está a punto de morir cuando Jack, un policía recién retirado, la rescata. Juntos deberán enfrentarse a los criminales y reunir pruebas para desenmascararlos.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Tras una pandemia que ha devastado el mundo, John Wood, un exsoldado, vive aislado en una cabaña en el bosque. Su refugio se ve alterado cuando María, una joven que ha escapado de un laboratorio, llega buscando ayuda. En su sangre podría estar la cura de la enfermedad, pero un grupo de mercenarios la persigue. John se une a un grupo de soldados para protegerla y enfrentarse a ellos.

programme.title: Shorta
programme.desc: Jens y Mike patrullan el gueto de Svalegården cuando la muerte de Talib, un joven de 19 años bajo custodia policial, desata la ira de los jóvenes. Atrapados por una multitud sedienta de venganza, ambos deberán luchar para encontrar una salida.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo. Su misión se convierte en un riesgo aún mayor cuando la hija de Chalmers es secuestrada por el peligroso grupo terrorista The Pardoners.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Épica historia basada en hechos reales. Durante el reinado del sádico Vlad “El Empalador” 7 guerreros emprenderán una peligrosa travesía llena de trampas y enemigos, que les llevará a una gran batalla final con Vlad y su ejército. El destino de un pueblo está en juego, y darán la vida para liberarlo.

programme.title: Hansan
programme.desc: Basada en la decisiva batalla de la Isla Hansan. En 1592, el almirante Yi Sun-sin y su flota se enfrentan a la poderosa armada japonesa invasora y sus formidables buques de guerra. Cuando las fuerzas coreanas entran en crisis, el almirante recurre a su arma secreta, el barco tortuga, para cambiar el rumbo de una épica batalla naval.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente del servicio secreto británico se enfrenta a la misión de perseguir y eliminar a un terrorista suicida nacido en Gran Bretaña y a su célula terrorista

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Un hombre conduce por el desierto cuando unos hombres le roban la moto y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y deja de pensar en suicidarse, ya que ahora tiene un propósito en la vida: vengarse y recuperar la moto.

programme.title: We Die Young
programme.desc: Lucas es un adolescente pandillero en Washington D.C. que ve alterada su realidad cuando conoce a un veterano de guerra (Jean-Claude Van Damme). Encuentra en él una oportunidad única para que se convierta en el tutor de su hermano, y así evitar que siga sus mismos pasos marcados por el crimen. Esta decisión hará estallar la ira de la pandilla y la violencia en las calles.

programme.title: Pentathlon
programme.desc: En los Juegos Olímpicos de Seúl, en 1988, Eric Brogar, un atleta especializado en Pentatlon de Alemania oriental, decide desertar y fugarse con el equipo olímpico americano. Consumada la fuga, Eric se establece en Los Angeles, donde tiene una relación sentimental con una campeona de tiro, pero su relación se deteriora y acaba mal. Después de la caída del muro de Berlín, Eric consigue un trabajo como cocinero en un restaurante regentado por un afroamericano. Cuando su jefe se entera de que era un atleta de elite, campeón de las olimpiadas, le anima para que se ponga en forma y vuelva a la competición.

programme.title: Contrición
programme.desc: Cuando Tara una joven thailandesa con poderes místicos desaparece, Axe y su viejo equipo de compañeros inician su búsqueda

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Un piloto de lanchas millonario lleva una doble vida, haciendo negocios con el gobierno de EE. UU. y los cárteles de droga.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: En un futuro próximo, un Navy SEAL acusado injustamente de crímenes de guerra recibe una oportunidad para recuperar su libertad participando en un programa de televisión en el que debe superar en ingenio a otros asesinos profesionales para sobrevivir.

programme.title: The Quest: En busca de la ciudad perdida
programme.desc: Un grupo de soldados de fortuna visita una legendaria "Ciudad Perdida", ubicada en el Tíbet. Planean robar una estatua invaluable.

programme.title: Pentathlon
programme.desc: En los Juegos Olímpicos de Seúl, en 1988, Eric Brogar, un atleta especializado en Pentatlon de Alemania oriental, decide desertar y fugarse con el equipo olímpico americano. Consumada la fuga, Eric se establece en Los Angeles, donde tiene una relación sentimental con una campeona de tiro, pero su relación se deteriora y acaba mal. Después de la caída del muro de Berlín, Eric consigue un trabajo como cocinero en un restaurante regentado por un afroamericano. Cuando su jefe se entera de que era un atleta de elite, campeón de las olimpiadas, le anima para que se ponga en forma y vuelva a la competición.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it’s her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf’s tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf’s tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat’s voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman’s daughter, the second one married the merchant’s daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds’ language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much; otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn’t you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn’t like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: A boy called Pasha was afraid of fairytale villains. He had read so many fairy tales that it got him really scared! Any trouble he faced was shifted to all kind of evil spirits… like Baba-Yaga. Only the courageous firefighters could assure Pasha that Baba-Yaga is not the reason for his troubles at all!

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You’ll see…

programme.title: Masha’s Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Masha tells an existing story about thunder and lighting and what might happen if the lighting suddenly catches you in the park…while you are enjoying your orange lemonade?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Alert! Bear’s fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear’s distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it’s Masha’s turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds’ language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. - One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar’s insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much; otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Who is the best cook in all the forest? Masha has no doubts as to how to correctly answer this question. And the proof is right before you: macaroni cooked by Masha herself. What can be simpler? Only Dasha is somehow sure that Masha's final product is inedible. As usual, Bear will have to solve the girls' dispute, as usual.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha enthusiastically plays with her "dolls", but Rosie wants to be independent. She trades places with wolves and now they are under Masha's care. Rosie enjoys adult life, but everything is not that simple ...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The wolves come up with a new idea how to get a stable and nutritious food source… they rob a poultry farm and get a…rooster. Meanwhile Masha and the hare arrange a real egg hunt for all their friends and neighbours! All forest dwellers are very excited to get chocolate eggs except for the wolves who long for some real food… Masha decides to help poor guys and arranges a splendid dinner!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Bright summer day. Bear, while gathering berries, meets female bear in the forest and arranges a date with her. Returning home, he starts cleaning the house and baking a pie. Once the pie is done, the Bear decorates it with strawberries. Masha eats them before starting to hiccup. The Bear tries all manner of remedies from a medical encyclo-pedia to stop the hiccups. In the end, hiccups spread to everyone including all other forest in-habitants.
