programme.desc: A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Viva! Django
programme.desc: Django is on the trail of some renegade outlaws who raped and killed his wife. En route, he rescues a horse thief from an impromptu hanging. He discovers the man knows who committed the murder. The men team up and head west for revenge.

programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: Gentleman Killer
programme.desc: A border town is thrust into political chaos when a Mexican bandit targets US soldiers, killing them relentlessly. As tensions escalate between the US and Mexico, the bandit becomes a symbol of defiance. The town becomes a battleground, with both sides caught in a dangerous game of revenge and retaliation.

programme.title: Black Tigress
programme.desc: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

programme.title: Return of Shanghai Joe
programme.desc: A sinister town boss called Pat Barnes has exploited almost everyone in the town.

programme.title: Requiescant
programme.desc: The adopted son of a preacher comes upon a village that is under the thumb of a deranged ex-Confederate officer, who is - among other things - stealing land from the locals with phony land grants.

programme.title: Professionals for a Massacre
programme.desc: During the Civil War, three outlaws face execution for selling guns to the enemy — until a Confederate general spares them. Their mission: recover a hidden fortune in gold under the watch of an officer. But rival treasure hunters turn their path to freedom into a deadly race.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
programme.desc: When bandits begin kidnapping Clayton City’s elite for ransom, Sartana is called in to restore order. But the gang’s mysterious leader sees him as a deadly threat and hires four expert killers to take him down. To save the town and expose the mastermind, Sartana must survive every trap and betrayal.

programme.title: Run, Man, Run
programme.desc: Several competing groups and mavericks (including the lead character Cuchillo) are hunting a gold treasure of $3,000,000. The gold was reserved for the Mexican revolution.

programme.title: My Name is Pecos
programme.desc: Everyone wants to know who the Mexican is. He always answer slowly, "my name is Pecos". Pecos Martinez to be exact, and he's returned to his hometown of Houston to settle up with Clain, the leader of a gang of cut-throats. Clain is busy looking for the money from a recent robbery that's been stolen from him. Soon the stolen cash in Pecos' vengeance entwine and all hell breaks loose. Behind the scenes a Bible touting Undertaker (Umberto Raho), a cowardly saloon owner, & a helpful saloon girl become part of the story. This film made Woods as internationally known as Pecos in the third world countries as Franco Nero was known for Django. A Mexican hero against a gang and a town full of gringos- what more could you ask for?

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.

programme.title: The White, the Yellow and the Black
programme.desc: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

programme.title: My Gun is the Law
programme.desc: In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad - until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town’s respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow

All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Little Miss Sunshine meets The Blind Side. Even losers can win! When an unlucky car salesman (Andy Garcia) finds himself thrown into caring for a homeless grifter (Dafne Keen) they embark on a cross country road trip to find her father. Loan sharks, side hustles and a lot of fun along the way, this car salesman soon discovers an old dog can learn new tricks.

programme.title: The True Don Quixote
programme.desc: Down on his luck, Danny (Tim Blake Nelson – HBO’s Watchmen) escapes the world by diving deep into the fantasy novels that bring him comfort. Diving a little too deep, he soon begins to believe that he himself is a great knight. Grabbing his cardboard armour, a sword and roping in his trusty squire Sancho (Jacob Batalon), they embark on an insane adventure, where great lessons are learned.

programme.title: Acts of Violence
programme.desc: How far would you go for the one you love? For the MacGregor brothers, that question becomes a life-or-death decision that tests their strength, courage, and sense of family. When Mia, the fiance of Roman MacGregor (Ashton Holmes: Revenge, A History of Violence), is abducted into a human trafficking ring, Roman and brothers Brendan (Shawn Ashmore: X-Men, The Following) and Deklan (Cole Hauser: Rogue,Olympus Has Fallen) decide to save Mia on their own. Theyre guided by Det. Avery (Bruce Willis: Die Hard, The Sixth Sense), the cop on the case whose sense of duty will be pushed to its limits and challenged by his colleague on the case Det. Brooke Baker (Sophia Bush: One Tree Hill, Chicago Fire). As the MacGregors sidestep official boundaries to rescue Mia, every second counts. But are they prepared for the ACTS OF VIOLENCE theyre about to experience?

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: A tense and high octane thriller from the producer of Nightcrawler. Cal (Jai Courtney: Suicide Squad) is a by-the-book police officer. When his reckless half-brother, Oyster (Nat Wolff: The Fault in our Stars), is given an unfair prison sentence, Cal driven by his loyalty to family and fierce code of honour fights for Oyster in this gripping tale of brotherhood and sacrifice.

programme.title: Cardboard Boxer
programme.desc: Touching and uplifting- this powerful tale of loss, redemption and friendship stars Academy Award nominees Thomas Haden Church (Sideways) and Terrence Howard (Prisoners) and Boyd Holbrook (Narcos). Living rough on the cruel streets of LA, Willie fights other homeless men to earn cash. But when he finds a young girl's diary in the bins, he is unaware that his life is about to change.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In London
programme.desc: The epic rise and fall of a nationwide criminal empire that lasted for three decades and paved the way for the notorious Kray twins to exert their dominance over the capital.

programme.title: Midnight Man
programme.desc: On a snowy night in her grandmothers sprawling mansion, teenage Alex and her best friend Miles discover a mysterious box hidden away in the attic. Inside are instructions for The Midnight Game, an ancient Pagan ritual said to summon the players greatest fears. It all seems like harmless fununtil they unleash the terrifying spirit of The Midnight Man, an unholy force who pits them against their darkest demons and dares them to survive.

programme.title: Honeydew
programme.desc: For Sam and Rylie an idyllic camping trip becomes an out of control nightmare. Seeking shelter on a local farm overnight when their car encounters trouble on the road, the couple find themselves at the mercy of an ageing farmer and her peculiar son.

programme.title: Just Before I Go
programme.desc: Courteney Cox (Friends) directs this hysterical comedy drama starring Seann William Scott (American Pie) and Kate Walsh (The Perks of being a Wallflower). In an effort to move on, disgruntled 41-year-old divorcee Ted Morgan travels back to his hometown to face the people who have made him the man he is today. But little does he know, he has the chance to find new hope and love!

programme.title: Time Runners
programme.desc: Special Agent Sally Biggs has a secret, she can rewind time - whenever she wants. It's enough to make her a celebrity at the FBI and control almost everything in her life. But when her scientist husband disappears mysteriously, paranormal apparitions begin to surround her before she discovers the terrifying truth.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: The night Abigail (Christina Ricci) meets Ben (Hamish Linklater) at a bar, they jokingly come up with a list of things to do before their imagined breakup, knowingly full well theyll never even start a relationship. But when the joke turns in to a one-night stand things become a whole lot more complicated.

programme.title: I Used To Go Here
programme.desc: A quirky coming-of-age story from the producers of Sorry to Bother You, starring Gillian Jacobs (Community) and Jemaine Clement (Flight of the Conchords). Her engagement is cancelled, her first book isn't doing well, and all her friends are having babies. Kate is in a real rut when she gets a call from her old university asking her to do a reading, where she gets sucked into college life again!

programme.title: Yuletide The Knot
programme.desc: When a small-town wedding planner is faced with planning her biggest Christmas wedding yet for an out-of-town couple, she is thrown an unexpected surprise when the brides manager turns out to be Logan, her first love and high school sweetheart. He reminds her what it is to love, and through rediscovering the magic of Christmas, she rediscovers a part of her heart she closed off long ago.

programme.title: Masters of Love
programme.desc: A funny, moving look at the complications of modern love, starring Edinburgh Festival Best Newcomer Ciarˆn Dowd (Drunk History). A group of friends are at different stages in their relationships and none of them are convinced about what they're doing: Emmy and Samantha are getting married, Josh and Jenifer are breaking up and Niall is sleeping around; but can any of them hold down a relationship?

programme.title: The Adventures of Wolfboy
programme.desc: Starring Chlo Sevigny and Eve Hewson. In the vein of Little Miss Sunshine, with a modern day fairy-tale surrealism that fans of Tim Burton will love. This inspiring, precious drama follows a young boy's coming of age tale as he navigates life with "Wolfman Syndrome" a rare condition that causes abnormal hair growth. On his 13th birthday he goes in search of his mother who abandoned him at birth.

programme.title: Plan A
programme.desc: A gripping, high voltage and action-filled thriller based on an incredible true story. In 1945 a group of young Holocaust survivors pledged to avenge the death of their people. Headed by charismatic Abba Kovner (August Diehl: Inglourious Basterds), they devised the biggest plan for Jewish revenge in history: to kill millions of Germans by poisoning their drinking water.

programme.title: Little Bone Lodge
programme.desc: From the producers of Fall comes a twisty thriller that will chill you to the bone. During a stormy night in the Scottish Highlands, two criminal brothers on the run seek refuge in a desolate farmhouse. But after taking the resident family captive, they find the house holds even darker secrets of its own. Colour Out Of Space star Joely Richardson (Nip/Tuck) stars as the fearsome family matriarch.

programme.title: Into The Ashes
programme.desc: With an honest job and a loving wife, Nick Brenner believed he had safely escaped his violent, criminal history. But his old crew, hasn't forgotten about him or the money he stole, and when they take what Nick now values the most, he has nothing left to lose. Confronted by the town sheriff, Nick must decide if he will stay on his new path or indulge in his need for revenge and force his enemies to pay for what they have done.

programme.title: Interlude in Prague
programme.desc: With lust and murder this is not your average costume drama! This powerful period thriller is a provocative twist on the Mozart biopic, starring James Purefoy (High-Rise), Samantha Barks (Les Misrables) and Aneurin Barnard (Dunkirk).1788, Mozart escapes Vienna for Prague, but his presence unleashes a series of dramatic events set off by a forbidden love affair with young soprano Zuzana.

programme.title: Boar
programme.desc: Get ready for some giant monster pig-on-the-loose fun with Boar. In the harsh Australian outback lives a beast with a ruthless, driving need for blood and destruction. And now it's venturing closer to civilisation. Brutality and hilarity go hand in hand in this monster movie, starring genre legends John Jarratt (Wolf Creek) and Bill Moseley (Texas Chainsaw 2).

programme.title: Here Comes Hell
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. Jack McHenrys astonishing feature debut is a pitch-perfect homage to Agatha Christie mystery horror thrillers. With cut-glass British accents and a dodgy American in the cocktail party mix, a sophisticated 1930s soiree at a country mansion descends into gore and demonic possession as rivalries and old friendships are put to the test. Sure to please fans of horror comedy!

programme.title: Hell Is Where The Home Is
programme.desc: Two couples renting a luxury home in the desert are thrust into chaos when a mysterious woman arrives, claiming car trouble and refusing to leave.

programme.title: White Mountain
programme.desc: This jaw-dropping climbing, Free Solo-esque documentary is a harrowing story of friendship, bravery and tragedy in one of the harshest environments known to man. 6 years after their trip to Dhaulagiri in the Himalayas to reach the peak of the almost mythical and rarely-climbed white wall, a group of Argentine climbers return to get closure on a fellow climber who was never to be seen again.

programme.title: Shelter
programme.desc: A high-octane, edge-of-your-seat thriller, starring Neta Riskin and Golshifteh Farahani. Israeli Mossad agent, Naomi is sent to protect Mona, a beautiful Lebanese informant who is recovering from plastic surgery to conceal her identity. In a safe house in Hamburg, the women form an unexpected bond, and experience a complex labyrinth of mistrust, loyalty, deception and betrayal.

programme.title: Shock and Awe
programme.desc: Based on shocking true events in the wake of the 9/11 terror attacks this thought-provoking political thriller stars James Marsden, Woody Harrelson, Jessica Biel and Tommy Lee Jones. Journalists Jonathan and Warren are covering George Bush's 2003 invasion of Iraq but become sceptical that Saddam Hussein was hiding "weapons of mass destruction", so challenge the White House. A race against time!

programme.title: Robin Hood: The Rebellion
programme.desc: The Raid meets Die Hard with a medieval twist, in this fast and furious new take on the legend of Robin Hood featuring the stars of Game of Thrones, Vikings and Torchwood. When Maid Marian is kidnapped by the Sheriff of Nottingham, Robin Hood must get a band of men together to save her. An audacious plan is set to penetrate the depths of the Sheriff’s castle to defeat the bloodthirsty tyrant.

programme.title: Extra Time
programme.desc: Former football star Troy is coaxed into rescuing the local footy team who have been told they will have to merge with a rival club or fold. Troy takes the controversial decision to team up with a nearby refugee support centre and take the community on a journey of change. But for some, it proves challenging. A hilarious and heart-felt comedy described as The Full Monty for the football pitch.

programme.title: My Zoe
programme.desc: An emotionally-engaging, heartbreaking family drama with a dystopian sci-fi twist, starring Julie Delpy (Before Sunrise), Richard Armitage (The Stranger), Gemma Arterton (Summerland) and Daniel Brhl (Captain America: Civil War). Top-level scientist Isabelle is forced to stay in contact with her ex as they are co-parent their daughter and when tragedy strikes she takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Mythica: The Iron Crown
programme.desc: Good and evil battle it out in the fourth gripping adventure from the fantastical franchise. When daring young wizard Marek steals the final piece of the all-powerful Darkspore she embarks on a desperate quest to deliver the cursed artefact to the gods. But is caught in a death race between a ruthless team of elite mercenaries and a trinity of demons.

programme.desc: The Mulsanne, Bentley's flagship car, provides luxury like in a first class hotel and elegance like an Armani suit. In addition: the Rolls-Royce Ghost. And: the high-tech coupe by Mercedes, the S 63 AMG with its V8 twin-turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the i8, BMW tried to show the automotive world that they were ahead of their time. But why would anybody pay much more for a car that’s slower and less affordable than the brand's M4 and less spacious than the M5?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Porsche's 911 GTS closed the gap between the S and the GT3 in their sports car model range. Also: the Roding Roadster, a handcrafted lightweight sports car with technology by BMW at its core.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car On TV, car fans from the Middle East can have their darlings rated in terms of speed, style and sound. Included this time: a Nova SS, a special Honda Accord and a car clad in crystals.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: The "Walk" at JBR in Dubai is the venue for our competition, as far as fancy and luxurious cars from all over the Middle East are concerned. This time, a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet are among the participants.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Chevrolet Corvette is the best-selling sports car in the world. It belongs to the USA like the Statue of Liberty, the Superbowl and John Wayne. Since its market launch the Corvette has developed into an automotive icon.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: 50 years of Porsche 911, 60 years of Chevrolet Corvette: two legends, two myths, two dream cars, and two philosophies. The Porsche 911 and the Chevrolet Corvette are the sports car icons in Europe and the USA.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In no other industry is marketing as important as in the automotive industry. Brands, models and advertising campaigns have been closely intertwined for decades. How has car advertising developed since the 1990s? Part 3 of 3.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Three extraordinarily sporty SUVs are the Porsche Macan Turbo, the Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and the Audi RSQ3. Each of these is able to easily cope with each season of the year and, in regards to performance, could be mistaken for a sports car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Panamera Turbo S is one of the most dynamic sedans in the world. In addition: the Jaguar XJR power sedan with a 550 hp V8 engine and Mercedes' extraordinary four-door coupe CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Lexus was one of the pioneers when it comes to electric and hybrid cars. The brand's LS 600h, the BMW Active Hybrid 7 and the Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid are prime examples of this mixture between combustion and electric propulsion.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. Also: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: With its extravagant design the Lexus NX200t definitely stands out. Infiniti, Nissan's luxury division, is more conservative in that regard. The QX30 features a classic Infiniti design with a curved bonnet. Also: the city SUV Mazda CX-3.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The S version of the Jaguar F-Pace is a tough competitor for Porsche Macan Turbo other rivals. Also: Audi launched its SQ7 as the most powerful diesel SUV on the market. And: the Bentley Bentayga, the first luxury class SUV in the world.

programme.title: Put Your Car On TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Audi is one of the most successful car manufacturers of the present day. The brand with the four rings stands for innovation, superior technology and unique design. Founded over 100 years ago, Audi is now a successful global player.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In 1932, the economic crisis led to the merger of the Horch, DKW, Audi and Wanderer brands under the name Auto Union, the second largest German car manufacturer at the time, which made motor sport history with the famous Silver Arrow racing cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Aston Martin's Vantage N430 model is a sports car that makes drivers and enthusiasts feel the heritage of British race cars. Also: a combination of elegance and power, the Bentley Continental GTC Speed with its W12 Twin Turbo engine.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: A cattle rancher's daughter (Susan Hayward) turns Oklahoma wildcatter with a geologist (Robert Preston) and an Indian (Pedro Armendáriz) as partners.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his sidekicks lure outlaws out of Oklahoma to justice in Texas.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: A Boston socialite (Jo Ann Sayers) attracts a ruffian (Victor Jory) along the Mexican border circa 1915.

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

programme.title: The Gunman From Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

programme.title: Hands Across the Border
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
programme.desc: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

programme.title: The Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

programme.title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

programme.title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

programme.title: Six-Gun Trail
programme.desc: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's friend, Gertrude, a nice, plain-looking girl expresses her envy of the happiness Samantha has found in marriage. Although Darrin tries to avoid getting mixed up in matchmaking, Samantha persuades him to bring Kermit, a handsome artist, home to dinner to meet Gertrude. Kermit falls for Gertrude. Although Samantha will mot admit it, Darrin suspects Gertrude is a witch and tries to break up her romance with Kermit. Darrin arranges a meeting at a nightspot for Kermit with Susan, a former girl friend. There, Samantha uses witchcraft to get Susan into an argument with Kermit. Susan storms out, unable to recall what has happened. When Gertrude arrives, according to Samantha's plan, Kermit proposes to her.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: An 86-year-old woman is stabbed and strangled in her home, within the secure walls of the upscale gated community of Canyon Lake, California. Before the body is cold, another elderly woman is brutally slain. Investigators can’t find a motive, and the violence against the frail victims is so shockingly over-the-top, they fear there’s a psychopathic serial killer on the loose. While the community cowers in fear, and people move their elderly parents out of Canyon Lake, police race to stop the killer in time. In their investigation, they dig deep for the scanty forensic evidence, befriend potential suspects, and are appalled by a callous post-kill ritual that becomes the murderer’s trademark.
